Ambushes waders from black bog-pools, latching on to drain stamina and spawn smaller bloodsuckers.
Flanks shield-walls using short curved hatchets and stolen Border Levy bucklers, retreating when outnumbered.
Lurks beneath collapsed bridge piers, lunging at wounded stragglers with ragged iron-stained claws.
Darts out from submerged wicker fish-traps to snap at ankles and drag light infantry into deep channels.
Advances steadily through knee-deep water, radiating a corpse-chill that stiffens bowstrings and joints.
Swoops down canyon walls in Lantern Passage to snatch helmets and drop loose scree onto casters.
Scampers around abandoned quarry kilns hurling hot cinders and igniting oil-soaked brush.
Charges down forest trails with iron-hard thorns tangled in its velvet rack, impaling frontline scouts.
Swarms isolated archers in tight cellars, inflicting festering bites that halve potion effectiveness.
Phases through wooden barricades to chill targets and drain mana with spectral tally-chains.
Clings motionless to grey stone walls until prey passes beneath, then drops with crushing pincers.
Stands immobile in burned turnip rows before lashing out with rusted scythe-blades when flanked.
Puffs its throat sac to belch clouds of stinging marsh-bile across narrow boardwalks.
Crawls slowly along damp brick arches, secreting an enzyme that pits iron weapons on contact.
Hurls pitch-soaked firebrands at wooden palisades and buffs nearby raiders with howling war-chants.
Spins rapidly across salt-pans, blinding archers with stinging white grit and deflecting arrows.
Coils behind red sandstone hoodoos, spitting blinding venom at casters from medium range.
Swings twenty-foot lengths of rusted ironstone shackles in wide arcs to trip and drag infantry.
Orbits fractured quartz monoliths, discharging sudden arcs of static lightning into armored targets.
Circles slow infantry columns, firing barbed horn-bow volleys before darting behind dunes.
Stands rigid beside sandstone vault doors until seals are broken, then strikes with bronze khopeshes.
Fixes a single target with a calcifying glare that slows movement before lunging with crushing jaws.
Perches high on canyon ledges, pelting exposed heads with leaden bullets that stun through light caps.
Burrows beneath muddy causeways, erupting around stationary tanks to sap health and slow retreats.
Pulses necrotic waves every few seconds, weakening nearby healing spells until shattered.
Clamps frontline warriors in heavy pincers while striking over its back with a paralyzing stinger.
Hangs back behind tomb guards, casting hexes that increase mana costs and rot leather armor.
Fires heavy steel-tipped quarrels from behind tower pavises, retreating to reload between volleys.
Projects shimmering heat-decoys ahead of itself to draw fire while flanking isolated healers.
Slouches out of bubbling bitumen seeps, slinging sticky pitch globs that root units and amplify fire damage.
Wades ashore with the rising tide, entangling melee fighters in wet, strangling sea-wrack.
Uses boarding hooks to pull casters out of formation before slashing with heavy cutlasses.
Dives relentlessly on wounded targets, inflicting bleeding scratches and disrupting spellcasting.
Advances slowly with high physical resistance, periodically venting scalding steam from chest cracks.
Clings to wet cavern ceilings above tidal causeways, dropping onto stragglers with paralyzing tentacles.
Channels arcing lightning bolts between metal-armored units and erects static barriers.
Disguises itself as a washed-up sea-chest or pitched cargo barrel before snapping shut on looters.
Floats above deep water ignoring terrain obstacles, chilling targets with ghostly fog-touch.
Scuttles out of steaming basalt vents above Oakhaven, spitting boiling seawater at close range.
Advances behind copper-plated boarding shields while hurling glass incendiary flasks.
Tolls a hypnotic maritime chime that pulls nearby units toward deep water hazards.
Circles above Night Orchards, screeching to buff undead minions and peck at blinded foes.
Sprints along narrow iron catwalks, biting through shields and shredding armor.
Surges forward in a wave of freezing surf that knocks back frontline pikemen.
Exhales a grave-stench aura that saps stamina regeneration while clawing ferociously.
Leaps across magma cracks, leaving burning paw-prints and biting with white-hot obsidian fangs.
Brands targets with searing runes that detonate if the victim casts a spell within four seconds.
Perches motionless on basalt battlements until enemies pass, then dives with razor-sharp wings.
Reforms from drifting cinders unless slain with cold or astral magic, choking lungs with soot.
Pulls metal-armored warriors inward every few seconds while slamming the ground with lodestone fists.
Holds narrow obsidian bridges in tight formation, hooking shields and thrusting with burning polearms.
Straifes battlements with toxic sulfur-spit and lashes tails tipped with glowing slag-barbs.
Charges recklessly swinging red-hot censer chains, growing faster and deadlier as its health drops.
Teleports behind backline casters from shimmering air-cracks, slashing with silver-edged claws.
Crawls slowly across basalt bridges, leaving wide trails of molten slag that block infantry advances.
Projects a rotating arcane shield that reflects frontal projectiles while firing astral beams.
Drops from ash-choked rafters onto distracted archers, draining mana and inflicting coughing stuns.
Calls down delayed pillars of white caldera flame on clustered squads while shielded by ember-wards.
Tethers itself to a party member, transferring half of all damage it takes to the bound victim.
Darts swiftly in packs around elder drakes, snapping with molten-glass jaws that inflict heavy bleed.

Your ledger closes in wet tallow and dried blood; the Salt Tithe claims another unpaid name.
Cold iron slips from numb fingers while crows gather above the silent tollhouse.
No lantern answers from the river ford. Only silt and drifting ash mark where the company stood.
Under Third-Dynasty Probate Law, a fallen debtor's ribs belong to the next bailiff who passes.
The wardstone hum fades in your ears, replaced by the slow drip of groundwater on rusted mail.
Shaved silver groats spill across the mud—worthless now to the hand that counted them.
Your bowstring snaps in the sleet, and the treeline closes around the last standing banner.
The telluric valve ruptures without a ground; ozone and cinder swallow the final invocation.
A cracked helmet rolls into the drainage ditch, leaving the Alder Bridge unguarded until dawn.
No quartermaster will tally this loss; the Border Mint burned cleaner records than your bones.
Alkali dust fills your visor as the desert wind erases every bootprint behind the caravan.
Ironheart's sluice-gates stay bolted shut while your company bleeds out onto dry limestone.
Whale-oil slicks catch the last spark, turning the harbor stones into a smoking pyre.
The tide rises through the Sunken Citadel, sealing helm and cuirass beneath cold black brine.
Your grounding rod snaps under the surge, and the storm leaves nothing but vitrified glass.
Caldera ash settles thick over fallen shields, burying steel and oath alike before nightfall.
Even star-iron bends when the hammer falls too late; the Obsidian Dais claims its toll.
The Anchor Seals groan deeper beneath the sea, indifferent to one more broken vanguard.
A cold draft extinguishes the camp brazier. Tomorrow another sellsword will take your contract.
Bitumen and copper wire await the unclaimed dead—pray the Scriptorium never finds your corpse.
Your last healing phial shatters on stone; the red stain dries faster than winter rain.
None of the Twelve walked out of that gorge. Only silence returns to the watch-post.
The road to Ironcamp is paved with better captains than you—and none of them turned back either.
Venom turns the blood to marsh-silt before a single prayer can reach the dry air.
Your name is struck from the muster roll with a blunt thumb of charcoal.
Steel rings once against basalt, then only the wind through empty ribcages remains.
The fog drinks the torchlight whole, leaving the frontier one company poorer.
No bell tolls in Thornwick for mercenaries who die beyond the outer palisade.
Your shield-arm drops; the breach widens; the chronicle ends mid-sentence.
Ashkarath's furnace does not mourn its fuel. Rise again, if any silver remains to buy steel.
